landing.heroSubtitle: Understand your contracts in plain language
landing.heroBody: We transform legal and official documents into language anyone can understand. Contracts, terms, court notices — no surprises.
landing.howSubtitle: In just four simple steps, get complete clarity on any document.
landing.step1Desc: Paste a URL, take a photo, or upload a file (PDF, image, etc.)
landing.step2Desc: Our AI agents identify clauses, calculate risks, and translate legalese.
landing.step3Desc: Risk score, plain language explanation, and actionable recommendations.
landing.step4Desc: Send via WhatsApp, email, or save for later.
landing.profileElderlyPain: Can't understand Social Security letters, medical prescriptions, or bank contracts
landing.profileElderlySolution: Audio explanation + large text + simple language
landing.profileWorkerPain: Can't interpret digital work cards, benefits calculations, or rental contracts
landing.profileWorkerSolution: Direct summary of what to do + document generation
landing.profileStudentPain: Doesn't read TOS of apps they use, doesn't understand exam notices
landing.profileEntrepreneurPain: Can't decipher government bids, corporate agreements, or certificates
landing.profileEntrepreneurSolution: Structured analysis + key concerns + next steps
landing.profileCitizenPain: Receives a court summons and doesn't know what to do
landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need to understand your documents
landing.featuresSubtitle: Our AI analyzes every detail of your document, simplifies the language, and identifies what really matters to you.
landing.featureSimpleDesc: Translates complex legalese into clear, easy-to-understand text for anyone.
landing.featureAbusiveDesc: Automatically identifies terms that violate consumer protection laws.
landing.featureLegalDesc: Each clause comes with a reference to the relevant consumer protection law.
landing.featureOcrDesc: Extracts text from photos and document images with high accuracy.
landing.featurePrivacyDesc: Your documents are processed securely and never stored.
landing.featureScoreDesc: Visual score from 0 to 100 showing the overall risk level of the document.
landing.statsSubtitle: Based on consumer protection and data privacy laws, ensuring your rights are respected.
landing.ctaSubtitle: Choose how you want to submit your document and get a complete analysis in seconds.
landing.ctaUrlDesc: Paste a link to a document, terms of service, or online contract.
landing.ctaCameraDesc: Take a photo of the document or choose an image from your gallery.
landing.ctaFileDesc: Upload a PDF, DOC, DOCX, or document image (up to 10MB).
landing.ctaDisclaimer: Your documents are processed securely and are not stored on our servers.
